a.lede: Researchers at The Citizen Lab have for the first time released technical evidence of sophisticated mercenary spyware being distributed via online advertising.
a.title: ‘Nightmare Scenario’: Zero-Click Spyware Is Infecting Phones via Targeted Ads

b.lede: A new type of spyware dubbed "AdFection" is infecting phones and computers via global online advertising networks.
b.title: CitizenLab details new spyware triggered by online advertising
